title: Global Boiling Hits France
author: T.J. Coles
content:
“When are we going out, Dad?”, Uno, my wife’s guide dog, seems to ask me with
his wide, restless eyes. The bored labrador can’t bear the warm fabric of his
bed and prefers the cooler floor tiles. “Sorry, boy, but it’s too hot
